# Vivek Parmar

> Vivek Parmar is a software engineer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. His portfolio covers professional experience, software projects, technical skills and a downloadable resume.

Vivek works with Sitecore, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), .NET, Angular, React and JavaScript. His portfolio also includes Next.js, MySQL, MongoDB and Redis.

- [Homepage](https://vivekparmar.vercel.app): Professional overview and public profile.
- [Experience](https://vivekparmar.vercel.app/#experience): Software engineering work at eInfochips and an internship at Innoventix Solutions.
- [Skills](https://vivekparmar.vercel.app/#skills): Web development, CMS, database and CI/CD skills.
- [Projects](https://vivekparmar.vercel.app/#projects): E-commerce Website, Speak N Do Application and Portfolio.
- [Resume](https://vivekparmar.vercel.app/resume): Resume page with a PDF download.
